title: Product Feature Schedule of the Rate Increase Offered on Certificates of Deposit
content:
One tier of the Certificates of Deposit line lets the owner ask, during the term, for the rate to be raised. The schedule below states where the feature is offered and the window in which the request is accepted.

| Tier | Rate increases the owner may request per term | Months after the term start within which a request is accepted |
|---|---|---|
| 6-Month Certificate | 0 | not applicable |
| 11-Month No-Penalty Certificate | 0 | not applicable |
| 12-Month Certificate | 0 | not applicable |
| 18-Month Bump-Up Certificate | 1 | 15 |
| 36-Month Certificate | 0 | not applicable |
| 60-Month Certificate | 0 | not applicable |

The 18-Month Bump-Up Certificate offers one increase per term and accepts the request within 15 calendar months of the day the current term started. On the five tiers showing 0 the window column reads "not applicable", there being no request the window could bound.

The window of 15 months sits inside a term of 18 months, so the last three months of an 18-Month Bump-Up Certificate term fall outside it.
